text:
deploy-bot: Postdeploy smoke complete for release v2.14.0. EU sampling probe shows elevated p95 on embed route.

maya: seen the alert in console, p95 ~ 620ms vs baseline 240ms

juan: which probe? kv/warmup or full embed fanout?

liam: deploy-bot attached details:
```
probe: eu-west-1/embed-sample
window: 2026-03-21T15:03:00Z - 15:08:00Z
p50: 180ms
p95: 620ms
errors: 2x 503s (downstream)
```

maya: looks like steady tail, not a single spike

juan: allocation logs show one host with high GC around 15:04

liam: +1 that host was on model variant v3.1.2 (quant2)

maya: current options: rollback EU to prior model variant (v3.0.9), or pin EU traffic to dedicated pool and investigate

juan: can we soft-roll a variant swap just in EU and keep global unaffected? prefer targeted fix
deploy-bot: initiating canary reroute: reroute 15% of eu-traffic to v3.0.9 for 10m

oncall-bot: alert muted for eu embed route during reroute window

maya: monitoring trace heatmap and synthetic coverage. watching p95 + error rate

liam: if p95 doesn't drop >30% in 10m we escalate to full rollback in EU

maya: acknowledged

(10m later)

deploy-bot: canary reroute completed; metrics update: p95 eu now 210ms, errors 0

juan: looks good. please post a quick note in #release-notes that EU variant pinned to v3.0.9 until further investigation

maya: adding to release notes: "EU embed route temporarily pinned to model v3.0.9 on 2026-03-21 due to p95 regression after v3.1.2 rollout; investigation ongoing."

liam: owners: eng-runtime + infra. I'll kick off a postmortem runbook and reproduce steps locally

maya: marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
